title: Life
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: After a middle-school best friend breaks off their friendship, high-school first-year Ayumu Shiiba copes by cutting herself. A new friendship with popular classmate Manami turns into class-wide bullying after a misunderstanding over Manami's boyfriend Katsumi, who also harasses and blackmails Ayumu. With support from classmates Miki and Yuki, Ayumu learns to stand up for herself over 20 volumes.
life_message: Real friendship and the courage to tell the truth let a person stop hurting herself and stand up to cruelty.

content.note: Bullying assaults, an attempted rape in a karaoke booth and a late stabbing (Wikipedia; MU Attempted Murder, Kidnapping).
Sustained bullying and stalking; ANN reviewer says it can come close to 'torture porn' (ANN; MU Dark Ambience).
Katsumi molests and blackmails Ayumu with nude photos; attempted rape; a teacher dates a student (Wikipedia; MU Attempted Rape, AniList Rape tag). Non-explicit per sources (to verify).
Insults and threats among students implied; not reported in detail (to verify).
A beer bottle scene and MU Drug/s tag; minor (Wikipedia; MU).
Ayumu's self-harm is central; Manami's suicide attempts (Wikipedia, ANN warnings self-harm and suicide ideation; MU Self-Harm, Attempted Suicide).
Bullying tactics, blackmail and cutting shown in detail; framed as harmful and overcome (Wikipedia, ANN).

dominant: Courage against bullying; friendship; mental health; failure of adults

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Ayumu reports Manami to police rather than retaliating (Wikipedia).

Order vs freedom.evidence: Rules fail her; friends, not institutions, help.

Civic vs kin.evidence: Classmates, not family, support Ayumu; family inattentive (Wikipedia).

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Manami's rich father and complicit teachers shown as abusing rank (Wikipedia).

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: No religious frame; personal courage and reason.

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Self-worth and standing up for oneself celebrated.

folkways.japan: Reflects Japanese school group dynamics, where conformity pressure and a teacher's 'peace at any price' stance enable bullying (ijime).

delivery.evidence: ANN calls themes partly unspoken, not preachy; message carried by Ayumu's choices and the exposure of Manami.

personified.ideology: institutional 'peace at any price' that silences victims

delivery.note: The bullies' views are shown through manipulative characters, though Manami is later given motives and a path to atonement.

winners_losers: Ayumu, Miki and Yuki prevail; Manami and Katsumi are exposed and face consequences; sympathy rests with the bullied and with honest friendship.
to_verify: Extent and explicitness of sexual-harassment scenes (Wikipedia and MU tags; ANN page did not list assault).
